blocks.title: if *9 out of 10* leads ghost after you send your price, this is why

blocks.caption: and no, it's not your price.
then they leave you on "seen", forever.

blocks.text: to them, $1,500 is just a number. they don't know yet what it fixes for them.
saying no feels awkward. so they "asked for the price and disappeared".

blocks.heading: "people enquiring and then ghosting", *every* single week

chat.text: it's $1,500 for 12 weeks. what made you reach out today?

blocks.caption: the price, plus one question. never a dodge.

blocks.text: a short nudge a few hours later. sometimes they just got busy and forgot.
it answers the price from your offer, asks the next question, and follows up to 3 times in 24 hours.

list: the price never ends the chat.
the serious ones book a call.
no more staring at "seen" at 1 a.m.
